summary: Accepted for host curation after independent sealed replay, direct Chinese source-context review, exact one-operation scope review, and chronology review. The phrase 周顯德初 places the report early in the Zhou Xiande era, whose first year is AD 954. It supports an inclusive lower bound of AD 954, but neither an exact event year nor an upper endpoint. The candidate makes precisely that replacement and leaves the separate Wang Congke research hold and former-ruler removal work unchanged.

sourceEvidence.quote: 周顯德初，有漢人自塞北而至者

reviewedChanges.reason: 周顯德初 means early in the Xiande era of Later Zhou. Xiande begins in AD 954, so the report cannot predate AD 954; 初 does not select a particular year within the early era and gives no terminating event. Replacing the spurious AD 954 point with an inclusive onOrAfter AD 954 bound retains the source wording without inventing exactness or an endpoint.
